fields.features:
UNBROKEN FOCUS — Your mental discipline allows you to channel internal force into movement and combat. - While not wearing Heavy or Very Heavy armor, you gain +1 Evasion. - Once per scene, when you would mark a Stress, you may resist by spending 1 Effort and meditating (free action). The Stress is not marked.

RESOLVE MOVES
Universal · Bear Down: Spend and roll, any number. After any Duality Roll, attack, reaction, or damage roll, before the outcome is narrated, spend Resolve Dice and add their total. The plainest refusal to fail.
Vanguard · Braced Step: Spend and roll 1+. After you are hit, reduce that damage by the rolled total before thresholds.
Vanguard · Overrun: Spend and roll 1+. Close one range band and attack, adding the rolled total to the damage.
Kinetic Echo (+Kinetic) · Shockwave: Spend and roll 1+. Your next melee hit adds the rolled total and knocks the target back a range band or prone.
fields.a_feattext: Spend 3 Hope to enter a focused combat state for the scene, turning discipline into decisive action.
fields.s_feattext: You can spend 2 Effort to enter the Disciplined State. It lasts a number of rounds equal to your Proficiency. While in this state: - Choose one Trait as you enter, Agility, Instinct, or Strength; you gain Advantage on rolls using that Trait for the duration. - You are immune to the Stunned and Dazed effects. - Your first Melee attack against an enemy while in this state deals an additional 2d6 damage (damage type by Subclass branch, Void, Kinetic, or Lux). - As you enter the state, you read the room: the Keeper tells you who is dangerous, who is bluffing, and who will break first. - While outnumbered in this state, enemies beyond the first to attack you in melee each round do so with Disadvantage. The discipline is a focus, not a fog of total superiority: you sharpen one line of your craft to a razor and hold it for as long as your training allows. The Awakened Vanguard's Path to Nirvana is described as a brief alteration of the substrate; the Sleeping Vanguard's Disciplined State is a deeper accessing of self. The substrate does not become more cooperative; you become more present.
